class.name: PolicySampler
class.brief_description: A learned policy's actions sampled for a batch of observations: normalised, through a multilayer perceptron, with Gaussian noise.
class.description: Samples a stochastic policy where the environments run: each observation normalised by running statistics ([code](x - mean) / sqrt(var + 1e-8)[/code], clamped to [code]+-10[/code]), a multilayer perceptron with ELU between its layers (computed as [code]exp(min(x, 0)) - 1 + max(x, 0)[/code]) giving each action's mean, noise of a learned standard deviation, and each sample's log-probability. The arithmetic is single-precision, as PyTorch's on the CPU; on macOS the layers' matrix products run on Accelerate. A training server uses it to sample its rigs' actions from weights sent once an iteration instead of a round trip to the trainer every step.

method.name: get_input_size
method.description: The first layer's inputs (the observation's size).

method.name: get_output_size
method.description: The last layer's outputs (the action's size).

method.name: mean_actions
method.description: The actions' means for [param rows] observations given row by row in [param obs].

method.name: sample
method.description: Sampled actions for [param rows] observations ([param rows] times the action size, row by row), followed by each row's log-probability under the Gaussian.

method.name: set_layers
method.description: Sets the layers: [param shapes] holds each layer's inputs and outputs in order, [param parameters] each layer's weight (outputs by inputs, row by row, as PyTorch's [code]nn.Linear[/code]) then its bias, in order.

method.name: set_log_std
method.description: Sets the noise's log standard deviation, one per action.

method.name: set_normalizer
method.description: Sets the observation normaliser's running mean and variance.
